label: Explicit event / action
description: Specific event/action predicate. Direct action verbs count fully; grammatically uncertain title-case verb forms count 0.75; speech/report/announcement acts and clear noun-led event references count 0.5. Independent of attention packaging so packaging is not double-counted.

label: Quantified detail
description: Fractional numeric detail: exact quantities/money/percentages/ages count fully; bare or spelled counts slightly less; years, scale words and ordinals are weaker; product/version/listicle numerals are discounted.

label: Time / place anchor
description: Explicit date/time/day or country/place anchor; NER place candidates are filtered for headline-case false positives, and facility-only anchors count weakly.

label: Causal relationship
description: Causal, consequence-linking or explicit relational language.

label: Material consequences
description: Impacts, costs, risks, jobs, health, harm, benefits or material changes.

label: Evidence specificity
description: Continuous evidence-surface score: documentary/legal/data evidence highest, typed research evidence next, direct testimony moderate, communication events or vague attribution low. Surface specificity only, not truth or methodological quality.

label: Context / comparison
description: Fractional context cue: explicit comparisons, trends, records or historical references count fully; amid/following count 0.75; bare sequence markers and comparative forms count 0.5.

label: Explanatory / service framing
description: Explanation, guide, mechanism, why/how question or explicit service-journalism framing; language presence only, not correctness.

label: Original-access cue
description: Explicit original-access/provenance cue: investigation reveals/found, exclusive interview/report/access, documents obtained, interview with, FOI or our-analysis. High precision, very low recall; diagnostic only because it is too sparse for stable source ordering.

label: Curiosity-gap restraint
description: Continuous curiosity-gap risk built from stock teaser phrases plus structural withholding cues: vague references, listicle examples, unresolved forward references, reaction/resolution gaps and pronoun/determiner load. Stored inverse is used in the composite; exported adverse rate is mean risk, not binary incidence.

label: Direct-address/service packaging incidence
description: How-to/you/your/search-capture framing. Often useful service journalism, but still a packaging/aggregation style; stored inverse is used in the composite.

label: Sensational / personal framing incidence
description: Strong sensational vocabulary or celebrity/personal-life teaser framing; stored inverse is used in the composite.

label: Near-identical cross-source headline
description: Near-identical title match at character n-gram cosine similarity above threshold; diagnostic only, excluded from the composite.
